stories.title: Provider Detail Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define response schema for provider detail lookup including NPI attributes (name, credentials, taxonomy, address) and validated external links (NPI registry, Healthgrades, state boards). Establish contract between service and facade.

stories.title: NPI Registry Lookup Logic
stories.description: Implement core logic to query CMS NPI Registry API, parse provider credentials, and normalize fields into the defined schema.

stories.title: External Research Link Generation
stories.description: Generate standardized external research links including NPI profile, Healthgrades, and supported state medical board pages based on provider attributes.

stories.title: Facade Integration for Provider Detail
stories.description: Integrate provider detail service into EvaluateCare facade, enabling tool-based access and ensuring compatibility with tool_router orchestration.

stories.title: Provider Detail Tests and URL Validation
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests validating NPI lookup accuracy, schema compliance, and correctness of generated external links including URL validation behavior.
